hints.title: Uniform Target Index Selection
hints.text: Given an array with duplicated elements, selecting any instance of a specified number with uniform likelihood requires isolating candidate occurrences.

hints.title: Pre-grouped Offset Arrays
hints.text: Group indices by their stored values during initialization. When queried for a target value, select one index uniformly at random from its precomputed list.

hints.title: Grouped Selection Blueprint
hints.text: In init: populate a dictionary mapping each number to a list of its indices. In pick(target): retrieve target list and return random choice from that list.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total elements in input array
complexity.notes: Constructor indexes elements in O(N); pick executes in O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the entire array on each pick call costs O(N) per query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trading O(N) auxiliary memory for pre-indexed offset lists accelerates repeated queries to constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understanding both the precomputed index lookup approach and streaming reservoir sampling trade-offs.
